'''The Rot''' was a disease afflicting the poor people of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A cure for the Rot was developed and available at [[Tydis Neutronics]], but most afflicted were unable to afford it until [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] cured the infected to win their support.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rot appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Nar Shaddaa.
